newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal airline warns pilots strike is illegal.
newsitem.headline: Portugal airline warns pilots strike is illegal.

text.p: Loss-making state airline TAP-Air Portugal warned its pilots on Tuesday that a two-day strike over working hours set for Thursday and Friday was illegal.
The company said unions representing the airline's 430 pilots did not give adequate warning of the stoppage which is timed to hit a holiday weekend starting on Friday.
"The whole period set for the strike is illegal," TAP chairman Manuel Ferreira Lima told a news conference.
He said the pilots, who announced their plans on April 16, could not start their action until Saturday under rules requiring 10 days' notice.

But a spokesman for the pilots union told Reuters that the stoppage, which would cover all flights except those linking mainland Portugal with its Atlantic Azores and Madeira islands, would go ahead as planned.
TAP, which the government wants to privatise next year, says that a two-day stoppage would jeopardise its chances of making a profit this year for the first time since 1974.
